title: heptapleurum stenophyllum
intro: Heptapleurum stenophyllum, commonly known as "Daru" or "Daru tree", is a plant species in the family Araliaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Heptapleurum stenophyllum include its use in treating fever, rheumatism, and as a general tonic, due to its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
